nodes.description: Mapping of token balances per address; mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Nested mapping of allowances owner=>spender=>amount; written by _approve.
Owner address controlling privileged functions; set in constructor from msg.sender.
Total token supply, initialised to 200 ether and adjusted by _mint/_burn.
Default burn percentage applied on transfers once listed.
Mapping of whitelisted addresses, written by addToWhitelist.
Mapping of penalised addresses checked during transfer anti-dump logic.
Constant maximum burn percentage (10) used when randomness branch 1 triggers.
Constant minimum burn percentage (0) used when randomness branch 2 triggers.
Constant bonus percentage (10) minted to sender when didGetBonus is true.
Flag enabling the anti-dumping penalty logic; disabled by disablePenalty.
Constant penalty window duration (20 minutes) added to listTime.
Flag indicating the token is listed (uniswap); gates burn/bonus logic in _transfer.
Timestamp captured at setListed, used to compute the penalty deadline.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, transfer sender and auth check.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for listing time, randomness and penalty deadline.
Initialises name, symbol, decimals, mints supply to deployer, sets owner and whitelists owner.
Owner-only function adding an address to the whitelist mapping.
Owner-only function adding an address to the redlist mapping.
Owner-only one-time listing activation; records block.timestamp into listTime.
Owner-only function permanently disabling the transfer penalty.
Uses keccak256 of block.timestamp and salt to pseudo-randomly return true 10% of the time.
Second timestamp-based pseudo-random predicate returning true when modulo equals 2.
ERC20 transfer entry point delegating to _transfer with _msgSender().
ERC20 transferFrom entry point performing transfer then allowance deduction.
ERC20 approve entry point delegating to _approve.
Increases spender allowance using SafeMath.add.
Decreases spender allowance using SafeMath.sub.
Core transfer logic applying timestamp randomness, burn percentages, redlist penalty and bonus minting.
Internal mint increasing _totalSupply and recipient balance.
Internal burn decreasing balance and _totalSupply.
Internal allowance setter writing the _allowances mapping.
View returning balance from the _balances mapping.
View returning remaining allowance from the _allowances mapping.
Token burn/bonus outcome derived from keccak256(block.timestamp, salt) - predictable miner-influenced randomness.
Anti-dump revert condition depending on block.timestamp and redlist membership of the sender.
Arithmetic computing toBurn/toSend and bonus amounts applied to balances and supply.
Sender address parameter of _transfer.
Recipient address parameter of _transfer.
Amount parameter of _transfer driving burn and send calculations.
Local variable holding the amount after burn deduction.
Local variable holding the computed burn amount.
Local flag set when the timestamp randomness grants the sender a bonus.
Local burn percentage, possibly overridden by randomness helpers.
Local deadline computed as listTime + penatlyDuration.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Amount parameter of the public transfer entry point.
Salt parameter combined with block.timestamp in the randomness hash.
Amount parameter of _mint used for bonus issuance.
Empty internal hook invoked by _mint and _burn before balance mutations.

edges.reason: constructor assigns owner and initial minted balance directly from msg.sender, fixing privileged control.
_transfer receives its sender from _msgSender() which is msg.sender.
addToWhitelist is gated by onlyOwner comparing owner to _msgSender().
addToRedlist is gated by onlyOwner comparing owner to _msgSender().
setListed is gated by onlyOwner comparing owner to _msgSender().
disablePenalty is gated by onlyOwner comparing owner to _msgSender().
listTime is written from block.timestamp, making listing state timestamp dependent.
get10Percent1 hashes block.timestamp into its pseudo-random decision.
get10Percent2 hashes block.timestamp into its pseudo-random decision.
Burn/bonus outcome of the unsafe randomness operation depends on block.timestamp.
Penalty revert condition compares block.timestamp against the computed deadline.
get10Percent1 result selects the maximum burn branch of the unsafe operation.
get10Percent2 result selects the bonus/minimum burn branch of the unsafe operation.
_transfer invokes the timestamp randomness helpers to decide burn and bonus.
_transfer executes the timestamp-based anti-dump penalty check.
_transfer computes toBurn/toSend and bonus amounts feeding the balance arithmetic.
_transfer calls _mint to issue the bonus when didGetBonus is true.
_transfer calls _burn for the computed burn amount.
transfer delegates to _transfer with the caller and recipient.
transferFrom delegates the value movement to _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance through _approve.
approve delegates allowance setting to _approve.
increaseAllowance updates the allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance updates the allowance through _approve.
_mint increases _totalSupply via SafeMath.add.
_mint increases the recipient balance in _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply via SafeMath.sub.
_burn decreases the account balance in _balances.
The penalty check reads redlist[sender] to decide whether to revert.
_transfer branches on isListed before applying burn and bonus logic.
_transfer initialises burnPct from BURN_PCT.
_transfer sets burnPct to maxBurn in the first randomness branch.
_transfer sets burnPct to minBurn in the second randomness branch.
_transfer uses bonusPct for the bonus mint amount.
_transfer adds penatlyDuration to compute the penalty deadline.
_transfer reads listTime when computing the penalty deadline.
_transfer conditionally executes the penalty path on penaltyEnabled.
addToWhitelist writes the whitelist mapping entry.
addToRedlist writes the redlist mapping entry.
constructor credits the initial supply into _balances[msg.sender].
constructor sets the owner state variable from msg.sender.
constructor calls addToWhitelist for the owner address.
_approve writes the _allowances nested mapping.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and deducts the caller allowance from _allowances.
allowance reads the _allowances nested mapping.
sender parameter is consumed by _transfer to locate and update balances.
recipient parameter is consumed by _transfer for the receiving balance update.
amount parameter drives all burn and send computations in _transfer.
toSend is derived from the amount parameter.
toBurn is derived from the amount parameter via mul/div.
_transfer assigns the toSend local variable.
_transfer assigns the toBurn local variable.
_transfer assigns the didGetBonus local flag from the randomness branch.
_transfer assigns the burnPct local variable.
_transfer assigns the penaltyDeadline local variable.
spender parameter of approve is forwarded to _approve.
amount parameter of transfer is forwarded to _transfer.
salt parameter is hashed with block.timestamp in get10Percent1.
amount parameter of _mint is added to supply and balance.
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter only exists as an input of _transfer and should be folded into its owning function node.
The recipient parameter is purely an argument of _transfer and carries no independent identity.
The amount parameter is consumed exclusively inside _transfer arithmetic.
toSend is a temporary local of _transfer whose lifetime is the function body.
toBurn is a temporary local of _transfer feeding the burn arithmetic.
didGetBonus is a transient flag local to the _transfer control flow.
burnPct is a transient local whose branches belong to _transfer.
penaltyDeadline directly parameterises the timestamp penalty check operation.
The spender argument is only meaningful within approve and its _approve call.
The amount argument of transfer is a direct input of the public entry point.
salt is only used inside the randomness helper and has no standalone semantics.
The amount argument of _mint is an internal input consumed by the mint arithmetic.
